title: Improve conditional κ to 0.00310676333 with a four-gate contact rewrite
body:
Use the earlier helper value to remove one internal contact. This raises the complete conditional **κ from 0.00310644469 to 0.00310676333**, a gain of **0.00000031864** over [PR #5651](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5651)'s corroborating replay of [PR #5650](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5650). This is a small construction gain.

The starting word is the released PR #5643 / #5644 composition from [PR #5650](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5650). Its exact input is retained and checked. The new four-gate schedule replaces `h-=4s; c+=2s; c-=x/2; x+=h` by `c+=h/2; h-=4s; x+=h; c-=x/2`, at the specified legal native frames. The local paid change is **−2 H1 + H2**, with no target loss. The complete caller removes 18 paid requests and retains 12,958 productive fields and rank surplus 760.

| Quantity | [PR #5651](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5651) | This contribution |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Complete paid requests | 66,492 | 66,474 |
| Productive fields | 12,958 | 12,958 |
| Conditional κ | 0.00310644469 | 0.00310676333 |

The unique raw crossing is `(0.00310676334487,0.00310676334488)`. The tested saving is 0.003106763335, with reserve 10^-12. Every local/helper/native map, adapter, thin query, idle, owned operation, restoration and route remains charged. The constructor changes the scalar graph; it does not merely choose more decimal places below an old invoice ceiling.

The package includes the exact witness, complete emitted word, source pins, proof, complete receipt, explicit normal/optimized replay hook, finite pattern census and corruption controls. At scientific commit `1f5a93245540e79be6ff4e7d573bbaf823a9dc23`, the complete registered normal and explicit optimized replays pass. They check all **565,504 endpoint coefficients, 2,917 native maps and exact phases, the physical caller, two interval engines, compiler costs and 58 outer predicates**. The official export also passes from a read-only directory with no Git and `PATH=/nonexistent`; all 23 exported files keep their bytes and modes. Six actual one-byte source corruptions reject before source import and are restored exactly.

Publication head is `3b0b4f37d5005f381ed9cfcccebfbe1ab35c71aa`. It changes only validation/proof prose and adds the corruption receipt after the full replay. All scientific code, inputs, emitted word and complete result remain byte-identical. Metadata, source pins, committed bytes and official export integrity pass again at this head. The README and proof were rendered through GitHub Markdown and their table/code text checked. Full-history ancestry is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Hosted CI and independent scientific review remain separate; current main has a reported missing-navigation-link failure in the shared planner.
